_about: Short factual summaries for model pages. The spec sentences were drafted by a local model (gemma4:12b) from the verified spec fields listed in source_fields (data/compare-specs.json and the maker-sourced body roster; sources cited per model), rule-checked so every number pairs with its spec, and hand-reviewed. Price wording is not stored here: the model page builds it at build time from today's listings (count, sellers, lowest, median, bundle share, 90-day trend). Models without enough verified specs (all lenses for now) have no entry on purpose.

It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 7.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 750 shots per charge, weighs 695 g with battery and card, and includes two card slots (CFexpress A/SD UHS-II + SD UHS-II) and a multi-angle rear screen.

camera-sony-a7c.name: Sony Alpha 7C
camera-sony-a7c.text: The Sony Alpha 7C has 24.2 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 740 shots per charge, and weighs 509 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7c-ii.name: Sony Alpha 7C II
camera-sony-a7c-ii.text: The Sony Alpha 7C II has 33 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 60 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 7 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 560 shots per charge, and weighs 514 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7cr.name: Sony Alpha 7CR
camera-sony-a7cr.text: The Sony Alpha 7CR has 61 megapixels, shoots up to 8 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 60 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 7 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 530 shots per charge, and weighs 515 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7r-ii.name: Sony Alpha 7R II
camera-sony-a7r-ii.text: The Sony Alpha 7R II has 42.4 megapixels, shoots up to 5 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 4.5 stops and a CIPA battery rating of about 340 shots per charge.

camera-sony-a7r-iii.name: Sony Alpha 7R III
camera-sony-a7r-iii.text: The Sony Alpha 7R III has 42.4 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 650 shots per charge, and weighs 657 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7r-iv.name: Sony Alpha 7R IV
camera-sony-a7r-iv.text: The Sony Alpha 7R IV has 61 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 670 shots per charge, and weighs 665 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7r-v.name: Sony Alpha 7R V
camera-sony-a7r-v.text: The Sony Alpha 7R V has 61 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records video up to 8K, with 4K at up to 60 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 8 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 530 shots per charge, and weighs 723 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a7s-iii.name: Sony Alpha 7S III
camera-sony-a7s-iii.text: The Sony Alpha 7S III has 12.1 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 120 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 600 shots per charge, and weighs 699 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a9.name: Sony Alpha 9
camera-sony-a9.text: The Sony Alpha 9 has 24.2 megapixels, shoots up to 20 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 650 shots per charge, and weighs 588 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a9-ii.name: Sony Alpha 9 II
camera-sony-a9-ii.text: The Sony Alpha 9 II has 24.2 megapixels, shoots up to 20 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It includes in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 690 shots per charge, and weighs 678 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-a9-iii.name: Sony Alpha 9 III
camera-sony-a9-iii.text: The Sony Alpha 9 III has 24.6 megapixels and records 4K video at up to 120 fps. It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 8 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 530 shots per charge, and weighs 702 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-fx3.name: Sony FX3
camera-sony-fx3.text: The Sony FX3 has 12.1 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 120 fps. It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 580 shots per charge, and weighs 715 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-fx30.name: Sony FX30
camera-sony-fx30.text: The Sony FX30 has 26 megapixels, records 4K video at up to 120 fps, and has in-body image stabilization rated up to 5.5 stops. It has a CIPA battery rating of about 570 shots per charge and weighs 646 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-zve1.name: Sony ZV-E1
camera-sony-zve1.text: The Sony ZV-E1 has 12.1 megapixels, shoots up to 10 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 60 fps. It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 5 stops, a CIPA battery rating of about 570 shots per charge, and weighs 483 g with battery and card.

camera-sony-zve10.name: Sony ZV-E10
camera-sony-zve10.text: The Sony ZV-E10 has 24.2 megapixels, shoots up to 11 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 30 fps. It has a CIPA battery rating of about 440 shots per charge and weighs 343 g with battery and card.

camera-fujifilm-xs10.name: Fujifilm X-S10
camera-fujifilm-xs10.text: The Fujifilm X-S10 has 26.1 megapixels, shoots up to 20 frames per second, and records 4K video at up to 60 fps. It has in-body image stabilization rated up to 6 stops and weighs 465 g with battery and card.
